description: ABS-01 (w3), ABS-03 (w3), ABS-07 (w2). Schema is ALREADY per-round (rubric_criteria.round_id; round PATCH accepts name/dates/anonymized/mode) — work is UI + one small migration. (1) Round cards become the edit surface: name, date pickers (inline 422 rendering), anonymized toggle (ABS-07 rides free), mode select, per-round Edit scorecard button; root cause is single-array criteria state seeded from rounds[0] (EvaluationPage.tsx:126,167). (2) Migration: criterion kind numeric|select|text + options + scale bounds. TRAPS: assertCriteriaTotal requires weights sum 100 — exempt non-numeric or force 0; editor has no add/remove-criterion controls — add them; criteria_scores wire schema is numbers-only (review.routes.ts:22) — widen. (3) Reviewer renders criteria from queue payload, stores them (kill hardcoded criteria_scores:null at ReviewerPage.tsx:270). (4) REQUIRED: Completed queue section with reopenable read-only reviews — ABS-S3 step 5 must reopen a submitted review to prove storage, else ABS-03 caps at partial forever. (5) Round 2 defaults to scorecard mode (seed + EvaluationPage.tsx:150); keep comparison selectable. (6) Rider: fix unconditional blind-mode redaction copy at ReviewerPage.tsx:420. Full spec: section T-B. Register rows 5,6,8,9. Collision: T-A owns the committee dialog in EvaluationPage.tsx — coordinate/rebase; whoever lands second rebases carefully (one-line JSX merges resolve cleanly and wrongly).
